disclosures.title: frames and weapons
disclosures.body: Hildryn with Blazing Pillage is the near-unanimous pick: stand on the excavator and spam Pillage. Octavia is the solo go-to (Mallet reflects at any level). Lavos with Valence Formation plus the Cedo, Wisp, Garuda, Gyre with augments and Nova with Null Star augments also work; Wukong for Defense, Limbo for Excavation. Take battery weapons, innate Toxin to bypass Corpus shields, Cerata, Xoris, Arca Plasmor or Tenet weapons.

disclosures.title: mission tips
disclosures.body: Survival: break every container and use life support capsules early; running dry near the end is the usual fail, and more players means more spawns. Excavation tracks Cryotic, not excavators, so run one at a time, bank its ~20 Cryotic and call the next. Eximus-heavy late stages (600+ Cryotic, last Defense waves) bring Nullifier stacks.
